topics.label: Introduction and Lecture Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecturer, outlines the scope of the cancer lecture series, and sets the learning objectives for the session.

topics.label: Cancer as an Evolutionary Genetic Disease and Sources of Mutation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish that cancer is an evolutionary genetic disease driven by accumulated mutations from endogenous cellular errors, inherited predispositions, and external exposures.

topics.label: Environmental Exposures and the Debate Over Cancer Causation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate everyday environmental exposures and epidemiological evidence to address whether cancer incidence is primarily preventable or the result of mutational bad luck.

topics.label: Infectious Pathogens in Cancer Development
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how infectious agents promote malignant transformation, focusing on the cooperative roles of viral infection and immune disruption in Burkitt lymphoma.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Chemical and Physical Mutagenesis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how specific chemical and physical mutagens damage DNA, emphasizing the role of xenobiotic metabolism in converting inert compounds into reactive mutagens.

topics.label: Tumor Promotion, Permissive Microenvironments, and Host Susceptibility
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how non-mutagenic tumor promoters, chronic inflammation, and host developmental stages create permissive environments for initiated cells to proliferate into tumors.

topics.label: Methodologies for Identifying and Proving Carcinogenicity
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics assess the laboratory and epidemiological methodologies used to identify mutational patterns and determine the carcinogenicity of environmental agents.

topics.label: Conclusion and Risk-Benefit Balance
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture by framing carcinogenic risk within everyday decision-making and summarizing key takeaways.
